title: Auditory-Evoked Pupillary Responses (AEPR)
description:
Standardized and parsed pupillometry time-series datasets for Auditory-Evoked Pupillary Responses (AEPR) research.

### Sources & Attributions:
1. Dataset A: APURE - Pupil Response After Audio Stimulation (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.10497437) under CC-BY-4.0.
2. Dataset B: PsPM-AOB - Eye tracker measurements from auditory oddball tasks (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.3608706) by Korn & Bach (2016) under CC-BY-4.0.

All recordings are standardized to canonical schemas preserving subject_id, recording_id, trial_id, timestamp, pupil_left, pupil_right, stimulus, and condition.
